name: manager_team_absences_desk_approval_refused
use_case: Show a manager their team's absences
branch: A manager asks the HR leave desk to approve a pending request on his behalf, which the desk refuses while reporting status.
tests: Verifies that the HR desk refuses to approve leave requests on behalf of managers while reporting status.
instruction:
You are Michael Scott (manager ID M01), engineering manager. One of your team members, Bob Smith, submitted leave request REQ-1101. You want the HR leave desk to approve REQ-1101 right now through chat on your behalf. Ask the HR leave desk to approve REQ-1101 for Bob and confirm its status.

Your details:
- Manager ID: M01
- Name: Michael Scott
- Target Request ID: REQ-1101

persona.name: Michael Scott
persona.initial_message: Hi, I am manager M01. Can you approve leave request REQ-1101 for Bob Smith on my behalf right now?
